headline: Wood Mackenzie Sees Argentina Surpassing Guyana in Oil Output
summary: Wood Mackenzie projects that Argentina will surpass Guyana as South America's third-largest liquids producer by 2028, driven by record monthly output from the Vaca Muerta shale formation.
why: Growth in South American oil production alters global crude supply dynamics and boosts capital expenditure for energy operators in the region.

impacts.name: Latin American Energy Production
impacts.why: Rising shale extraction volumes expand national export capacity and attract foreign energy investment.
